key.name: hidden
key.description: When true Bavi is hidden and all of her timers and animations are stopped.

key.name: paused
key.description: When true Bavi freezes where she is: no roaming, no idle animation, no pointer tracking.

key.name: quiet-mode
key.description: When true Bavi stays at her home position, does not roam and has no idle bobbing. She still reacts to clicks and still looks at the pointer.

key.name: focus-mode
key.description: When true Bavi stays at home with her back to you, completely still, and ignores the pointer. Clicking her still gets a short reaction.

key.name: roaming
key.description: Allow Bavi to walk away from her home position now and then and return.

key.name: pointer-look
key.description: When the pointer is near, Bavi turns toward it.

key.name: character-height
key.description: Height of Bavi on screen in logical pixels.

key.name: home-corner
key.description: Corner of the primary monitor's work area where Bavi lives.

key.name: summon-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that makes Bavi come to the pointer. It also shows her if she is hidden or paused.
